title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-10-24
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains for the first seven entries; newly created active repositories are appended as supplements without daily gain rankings.
ranking_explanation: Ranks 1-7 follow the descending stars-today values displayed on GitHub Trending. Ranks 8-9 are relevant, non-fork repositories created in the last two calendar days, selected from GitHub Search by current stars and freshness; their daily star gains are unavailable and are not compared to the Trending ranks.
global_caveat: Point-in-time snapshot captured at 00:40 UTC. GitHub star totals and default-branch commits can change. The two Search supplements have no daily gain figure in this report; the date-based Search query uses calendar-day precision. No prior-window evidence was collected, so no Notable Shifts section is claimed.

themes.title: Agent security and controlled execution
themes.content: Security is the clearest measured signal: a multi-phase audit skill leads the Trending gain list, NVIDIA supplies an isolated policy-enforced agent runtime, and security-oriented repositories extend the pattern into skills and vulnerability detection.

themes.title: Composable agent skills and role workflows
themes.content: Several repositories distribute reusable capabilities as structured skills, plugins, connectors, or sub-agent workflows, targeting auditing, offensive-security research, and business roles.

themes.title: Established language and runtime infrastructure
themes.content: PHP's interpreter ranks third by daily gains, standing out as a mature core runtime amid the agent-heavy entries; the new PHP scanner further connects the language ecosystem to security response.

themes.title: Specialized generative AI and systems projects
themes.content: The remainder spans multilingual speech synthesis, a Chinese astrology charting/data engine, and experimental macOS-on-Snapdragon platform engineering.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Daily GitHub Trending snapshot captured 2026-10-24 00:40 UTC; date range 2026-10-24 through 2026-10-24 UTC. The first seven repositories are ranked by daily Trending star gains; two new-repository supplements have no daily gain data.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Security is the strongest signal: Cloudflare’s audit skill leads today’s page by a wide margin, while NVIDIA’s agent runtime and a newly created vulnerability scanner add momentum to the security-and-agent infrastructure cluster. The snapshot also has a striking incumbent-language outlier—PHP’s interpreter—and smaller spikes in role-specific agent plugins, speech generation, and a specialist Chinese astrology engine.

sections.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
sections.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings.
sections.content: A coding-agent skill coordinating reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, independent record verification, and structured reporting. It leads the captured daily Trending page by 2,716 stars.
sections.why_notable: Largest daily gain in the captured Trending view; its first-party README emphasizes coverage ledgers, independent verification, and schema-validated machine-readable findings.

sections.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
sections.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
sections.content: A Rust-based agent runtime with kernel-level sandbox enforcement and policy review using formal verification; it gained 1,119 stars in the daily Trending view.
sections.why_notable: Second-largest daily gain; its policy-controlled access and credential mediation address a concrete deployment constraint for autonomous agents.

sections.title: php/php-src
sections.content: The canonical PHP interpreter source in C; its 716 daily stars make it a notable established-runtime outlier in an otherwise strongly agent-oriented list.
sections.why_notable: Third by daily gains and a meaningful counterpoint to the newer AI and agent tools; it is a foundational language project rather than a trend-specific application.

sections.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
sections.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork.
sections.content: A catalog of role-focused plugins bundling skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for functions including sales, legal, finance, data, and research; it gained 635 stars today.
sections.why_notable: Its fourth-place daily gain reflects demand for assistants customized around concrete organizational roles and connected workflows.

sections.title: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu
sections.description: A Chinese Zi Wei Dou Shu charting engine based on the Ni Haixia Tian Ji system, with charting algorithms, transformation logic, pattern knowledge, and classical-text data.
sections.content: A TypeScript charting engine and data project for Chinese Zi Wei Dou Shu; its README describes a large generated interpretation dataset and clearly separates code and data licensing.
sections.why_notable: Fifth by daily gains and a strong non-English, culturally specific application in the list, with unusually detailed first-party dataset and licensing documentation.
sections.spoken_name: Zi Wei Dou Shu charting engine

sections.title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
sections.description: A curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system.
sections.content: A Python repository of structured offensive-security skills covering multiple attack surfaces, distributed as load-on-demand capability files for Claude workflows.
sections.why_notable: Its daily gain illustrates the skills-as-agent-capability pattern extending into security research and red-team use cases.

sections.title: OpenBMB/VoxCPM
sections.description: VoxCPM2: tokenizer-free text-to-speech for multilingual speech generation, creative voice design, and voice cloning.
sections.content: A Python speech-generation system using a tokenizer-free diffusion-autoregressive approach; the README highlights multilingual synthesis, voice design, controllable cloning, and high-quality audio output.
sections.why_notable: It represents a distinct generative-AI use case beyond agent workflows and remains highly starred despite a smaller daily gain than the leading entries.

sections.title: Snapintosh/Snapintosh
sections.description: EL2 hypervisor and toolchain that boots macOS on the ASUS Zenbook A16 with Snapdragon X2 Elite, including an Adreno graphics stack.
sections.content: A newly created, experimental platform project using an EL2 monitor, device models, and an Adreno driver stack to boot macOS on one specified Snapdragon laptop; this is a Search-discovered supplement, not a daily-gain rank.
sections.why_notable: Among the highest-starred non-fork repositories created in the last two calendar days; its README provides detailed architecture and status notes.
sections.unique_caveat: Experimental and limited to one specific laptop model; several hardware features remain unsupported.

sections.title: assetnote/php2shell-scanner
sections.description: A high-fidelity scanner for detecting CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 in PHP applications.
sections.content: A newly created Python CLI scanner that uses differential multipart probes to identify vulnerable PHP applications; it is a Search-discovered supplement, not a daily-gain rank.
sections.why_notable: It is a newly created defensive security project aligned with the day's security signal, with explicit detection logic and operational notes in its README.
sections.unique_caveat: The documented probes can send about 29 MiB per tested path; scan only systems for which you have authorization.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Security and controlled execution around agents dominate, with Cloudflare's multi-stage audit workflow, NVIDIA's policy-enforced sandbox, and skill-based security tools. Structured plugins and skills point to capability packaging for specific work. PHP's interpreter is the strongest established-runtime counterpoint. Other entries cover tokenizer-free multilingual speech generation, specialist Chinese charting/data software, and experimental platform engineering. Languages across the nine entries: Python 5; JavaScript 1; C 1; Rust 1; TypeScript 1.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s clearest thread is practical infrastructure around AI agents: auditing what they do, constraining what they can access, and packaging reusable skills for specific tasks. The strong PHP result and the variety of the remaining projects argue against reading the list as a single-theme AI wave. Two newly created projects broaden the security and systems picture, but their lifetime star totals should not be mistaken for today’s star gains.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured at 2026-10-24 00:40 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repo and current-commit endpoints for all listed repositories; GitHub Search for repositories created 2026-10-22 through 2026-10-24 with over 100 stars. The first seven entries follow displayed daily Trending star gains; the last two are Search supplements with no available daily gain. No prior-window evidence was used.
